title: Add ShoppingListDocument core types and public API surface
description: Create the new CookbookCore model types for `ShoppingListDocument`, `ShoppingListAisle`, `ShoppingListEntry`, `Block`, and `ItemIndex`, and define the public initializer, renderer, and mutation signatures that callers will use.
acceptance_criteria: `ShoppingListDocument.swift` exists with the structured model types and public API signatures described by the spec.
`ItemIndex` is represented as an aisle name plus position and is usable by downstream callers.
The new type is `Sendable` and `Equatable` where required and compiles as the new shared model surface.
